links.outcome: Agreement of foundational LLMs with physician consensus on medical ethics cases
links.effect: Foundational LLM agreement with physician consensus was slight to fair: Gemini κ=0, LLaMA κ=0.14, ChatGPT κ=0.32.
links.quote: There was slight agreement between the foundational Gemini and the physician consensus (κ=0), slight agreement between the foundational LLaMA and the physician consensus (κ=0.14), and fair agreement between the foundational ChatGPT and the physician consensus (κ=0.32).

links.outcome: LLM answer agreement against physician-panel reference standard before improvement
links.effect: Before improvement, LLMs matched physician consensus on 27 (ChatGPT), 22 (Gemini), and 26 (LLaMA) of 44 cases; agreement slight to fair.
links.quote: There was slight agreement between the foundational Gemini and the physician consensus (κ=0), slight agreement between the foundational LLaMA and the physician consensus (κ=0.14), and fair agreement between the foundational ChatGPT and the physician consensus (κ=0.32).

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt engineering (chain-of-thought, N-shot, question refinement, long context) to improve LLM alignment with physician consensus on ethics cases
